comment: Adapter board, not a pedal: an LM13700 and two resistors on a small perfboard that plugs into a CA3080 DIP-8 socket through long header pins mounted from the solder side (the pins are not listed as a row). The CA3080 drawn beside the diagram is the part being replaced, not a part of the board.
